declaration.reason: Owner-authorised coordinated shared-file protection cycle for src/App.jsx. This portal independently verifies the shared navigation-shell change while preserving its own authorization, data, workflow and governance boundaries.
declaration.expectedEffect: The shared application shell makes the complete Meeting Portal module set available to every identity with a Members or Employees register record, regardless of active status or selected authority. It does not change this portal's own data, workflows, permissions or role controls.
prohibitedChanges: Do not create portal-wide meeting leadership roles.
Do not allow Meeting Administrator to chair, vote, establish quorum, approve resolutions or approve minutes by virtue of that role.
Do not retain Transition Committee authority after formal proceedings begin.
Do not allow appointments or permissions to leak between concurrent meetings.
Do not weaken Board quorum, ordinary governance voting, signature, legal-hold, retention, audit or protected deletion safeguards.
Do not change unrelated Firestore collections or other portal permissions.
Do not alter this portal's internal source, data model, business rules or role permissions.
Do not weaken authentication, signing, invitation, deletion, audit, retention or deployment controls.
Do not grant meeting-specific leadership, live-room admission, voting, quorum or Board-record authority through general portal navigation.
Do not modify another portal's internals or use this shared-file record as a substitute for its independent lock tests.

behaviourDifferences: Only the exact TRIAL marker at creation qualifies; REAL, missing, invalid, lowercase or whitespace-padded values are non-deletable.

The shared application shell exposes Meeting Portal navigation to all Members/Employees register identities independent of status or selected authority; no internal portal workflow or authorization boundary is changed.
The cross-portal browser fixture isolation guard is a shared validation dependency and changes no runtime portal behavior.
